phases.caption: Move the left gripper inward and grasp the bag's lower-left fabric rim.
Move the right gripper inward and grasp the bag's lower-right fabric rim while the left gripper holds the opposite rim.
Rotate both grippers downward while holding the bag's opposite lower rims, folding and tensioning the lower fabric.
Release the lower-right rim, press it inward with the right gripper, and withdraw while the left gripper stabilizes the bag.
Move the right gripper inward and grasp the lower zipper pull while the left gripper stabilizes the bag's lower-left rim.
Pull the zipper pull toward the bag's upper end with the right hand while the left hand braces the opposite lower rim.
Return both arms to the demonstrated rest pose; keep both grippers unchanged.
